DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくしたカードの情報がわかる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have anything showing the details of the card you lost?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯にカードの写真があります。両面をメールで送ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: カード写真の両面を送ってよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have photos of the card on my phone. Should I email pictures of both sides?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may send photos of both sides of the card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 送る前に、担当が必要な確認方法をご案内します。今はカードの現物がないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Before you send anything, the person in charge will explain the verification method needed. You do not have the actual card now, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、現物はありません。写真があるので、持っているのと同じだと思いかけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真はあるが現物紛失で所持と混同しかけたと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: That is right. I do not have it. Because I have photos, I almost thought that was the same as having the card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have photos but lost the actual card and almost confused the two. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真の情報の取り扱いにも注意が必要です。紛失に気付いた時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The information in those photos also needs careful handling. When did you notice the loss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今朝です。写真を外へ送らず、まず紛失時の連絡先と本人確認の方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発見時刻を伝え外部送信前に連絡先と確認方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: This morning. Before sending the photos anywhere, I would like to know whom to contact about the loss and how my identity will be verified.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say when you noticed the loss and ask about the contact point and verification method before sending photos elsewhere. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へご案内します。別のカードの写真も入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will direct you to the person in charge. Do you also have photos of other cards?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。対象を取り違えないよう、カードの種類を説明しますが、全部の写真は見せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別カード写真と混同せず必要な対象のみ説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will explain the type of card so we do not confuse them, but I will not show all my photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain only the relevant card without confusing it with photos of other cards. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な資料だけ、案内に従って確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please follow the instructions and provide only the materials needed for verification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。写真だけで操作を進めず、担当に現物がないことを伝えて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真で自己操作せず現物なしを担当へ伝えると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not proceed on my own using just the photos. I will tell the person in charge that I do not have the actual card and ask for help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not take action yourself using photos and will tell the person in charge that the actual card is missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。対象カードと紛失の状況を確認し、適切な手続きを案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will check which card it is and how it was lost, then explain the appropriate procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品のどの部分が使いにくいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of the product is difficult to use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 保存容器のふたが閉まりません。中に料理を入れた状態で持って来ればわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 容器が閉まらず料理入り現物を持参するか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The lid of my food container will not close. Would it help if I brought it with the food still inside?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the container will not close and ask whether to bring it with food inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず容器の種類と状態を確認します。料理は入れたまま持参しなくて構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: First we will check the type of container and its condition. You do not need to bring it with food inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: わかりました。料理を入れたので返品できるとは決めませんが、不具合の相談をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 使用済みで返品可と決めず不具合相談を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. Since I have put food in it, I will not assume I can return it, but I would like to ask about the problem.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for help with the problem without assuming that a used item can be returned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ふたと本体の表示がわかるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have anything that shows the markings on the lid and container?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写真と購入のレシートがあります。家の別の容器のふたと混ざった可能性もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真とレシートを示し他容器のふたとの混在可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have photos and the purchase receipt. It is also possible that I mixed up the lid with one from another container at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the photos and receipt and mention that the lid may have been mixed up with another container’s. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 商品に合うふたかを担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check whether the lid belongs to this product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。無理に押して割る前に、表示を照合し、持参方法も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 無理に押さず表示照合と持参方法を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Before forcing it down and breaking it, I would like the markings checked and to ask how to bring it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to compare the markings and explain how to bring it in, rather than forcing the lid. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から確認に必要なものをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will tell you what is needed to check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、料理の入っていない状態で準備し、交換などは確認結果を聞いてから相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 中身なしで準備し確認後に交換等を相談すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will prepare it without food inside and ask about an exchange or other options after hearing the findings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will prepare the empty container and discuss an exchange or other options after the check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ふたの対応と現在の状態を確認して、相談の進め方をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will check whether the lid matches and its current condition, then explain how to proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらの道をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: What kind of route are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 段数が少ない道です。三段だけなら、こちらが楽だと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三段の少段数経路が楽だと思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: A route with fewer steps. If this one only has three steps, I think it will be easier.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you thought the route with only three steps would be easier. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 段数だけでなく高さや足元も確認しましょう。高い段差は避けたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check not just the number, but their height and the footing too. Would you like to avoid high steps?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、膝がつらいです。三段なら必ず楽と考えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 膝がつらく高さを考えていなかったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, my knees hurt. I assumed that only three steps would definitely be easy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your knees hurt and you had not considered the height. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 段差のない経路が利用できるか確認します。少し遠回りでもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check whether a step-free route is available. Would you mind a little detour?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、高い段を上るより遠回りを選びたいです。途中で休める所も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 段差なしなら遠回りもよく休憩所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not at all. I would rather take a detour than climb high steps. I would also like to know where I can rest along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that a detour is fine for a step-free route and ask about resting places. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在通れる道とベンチを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check which paths are currently open and where the benches are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。行きだけでなく、帰りに同じ段を下りる必要も含めて考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰路の下り段差も含めた確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I want to consider not only the outward trip but also having to go down those same steps on the return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to include descending steps on the return trip in the check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 往復で段差を避ける経路をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will show you a route that avoids steps in both directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。段数が少ない方へ先に進まず、案内が確認できてから歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 少段数で先に進まず経路確認後に歩くと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will not start along the route just because it has fewer steps; I will wait until the route has been checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait for route confirmation instead of setting off because there are fewer steps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。段差、距離、休憩を合わせてご自身の負担に合う道を選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13222-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Consider the steps, distance and resting places together and choose a route that suits your physical needs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符についてのご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about your ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買ったので昨日の日付があります。今日使うには買い直しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日の購入日表示で今日の買直しが必要か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bought it yesterday, so it has yesterday’s date. Do I need to buy another one to use it today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether yesterday’s purchase date means you need to buy another ticket today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その日付は発行日ですか、乗車日ですか。印字を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is that the issue date or the travel date? Let us check the printing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 発行日とあります。購入した日と乗る日を同じものだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発行日と乗車日を混同したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says issue date. I thought the purchase date and the date of travel were the same thing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you confused the issue date with the travel date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用できる日や列車を別の欄で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the permitted dates and trains in another section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。この切符が使えるか確認する前に、同じ区間を買い直したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重複購入前に現切符の利用可否確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I do not want to buy the same journey again before finding out whether this ticket can be used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check whether the current ticket is valid before buying a duplicate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご利用になる列車と行き先を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell me which train you plan to take and your destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日のこの列車で、この駅までです。券面の指定と合うか見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日の列車と目的地を示して券面と照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: This train today, to this station. Please check whether that matches the conditions printed on the ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show today’s train and destination and ask for a comparison with the ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合う条件を確認します。変更が必要なら方法も案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the applicable conditions. If a change is needed, we will explain how to make it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、使えないと自分で線を引いたり捨てたりせず、そのまま相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自己取消の線や廃棄をせず現物で相談すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not cross it out or throw it away myself because I think it cannot be used; I will bring it as it is and ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask with the original ticket without crossing it out or discarding it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。発行日、利用日、列車の指定を照合してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will compare the issue date, valid travel date and designated train before advising you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知の問い合わせ先についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about whom to contact regarding the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、この長い番号にかけましたが、つながりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長い番号でつながらなかったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I called this long number, but it did not connect.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you could not get through using the long number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 電話番号の後ろには、どのような説明がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: What instructions appear after the telephone number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 音声案内の後に二を選択とあります。二まで電話番号に付けていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 音声選択二を電話番号へ付けたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says to select two after the voice guidance. I had added that two to the telephone number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you added voice-menu option two to the telephone number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 電話番号と音声で選ぶ番号を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us distinguish the telephone number from the number you select in the voice menu.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。最初は電話番号だけにかけて、案内を聞いてから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話と接続後の選択を分けて操作すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will first dial only the telephone number, then listen to the guidance before selecting an option.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will separate dialing from selecting an option after connecting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 問い合わせの内容は通知に関することですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is your inquiry about the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、回答方法です。ただ、日本語の音声がわからなければ適当に番号を押したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不明音声で適当に選ばず担当相談方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, about how to respond. But if I cannot understand the Japanese guidance, I do not want to press a random number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not choose randomly when you do not understand the guidance, and ask how to consult the relevant staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当窓口へ相談する方法を確認します。通知の番号はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check how to contact the relevant desk. Do you know the notice reference number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この通知番号です。電話の番号とは混ぜず、相談時に伝えるためにメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通知照会番号は電話番号と別に記録すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is this number. I will write it down separately from the phone number so I can give it when asking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will record the notice reference separately from the telephone number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。連絡する番号、音声の操作、通知の照会番号をそれぞれお示しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will show you the contact number, the voice-menu steps and the notice reference separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お名前をご記入いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you write your name, please?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ここには、この病院を教えてくれた知人の名前を書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 患者名欄へ紹介してくれた知人名を書くか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Should I write the name of the acquaintance who told me about this hospital here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the acquaintance who recommended the hospital should be named in the patient-name field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 患者ご本人のお名前を伺う欄です。受診されるのはご自身ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This field is for the patient’s own name. You are the one receiving medical care, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、私です。紹介してくれた人の名前の欄だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受診は本人で紹介者欄と誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I am. I thought this was for the person who recommended the hospital.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are the patient and mistook the field for the recommender’s name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の書類と照合して受付します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check it against your own documents to register you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。知人が受診した時の診察券を借りて使わず、私の初診として進めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 知人診察券を借りず本人の初診として頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I would like to register as a new patient myself, without borrowing the patient card my acquaintance used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to register as a new patient in your own name without borrowing your acquaintance’s patient card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 知人からの紹介と、医療機関からの紹介状は別です。紹介状はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: A recommendation from an acquaintance is different from a referral letter from a medical institution. Do you have a referral letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありません。知人が勧めただけなので、紹介状があるとは答えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 知人推薦で紹介状はないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. My acquaintance only recommended the hospital, so I will not say I have a referral letter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear that you have a personal recommendation but no referral letter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 診療の希望を担当に確認します。症状もご本人から伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check your request for care with the person in charge. We will also ask you directly about your symptoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、知人と同じ診断だと思わず、私の症状と経過を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 知人と同診断と決めず自身の症状を伝えると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will explain my own symptoms and how they developed, rather than assume I have the same diagnosis as my acquaintance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will describe your own symptoms without assuming the same diagnosis as your acquaintance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご本人の初診として、受付方法と診療の案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will check the registration procedure and explain the care arrangements for your own first visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような物を拾われましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯電話です。着信に出たら、その人が自分の電話だから駅まで持ってきてと言いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾った電話の着信相手から駅へ届けるよう求められたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A mobile phone. When I answered an incoming call, the caller said it was theirs and asked me to bring it to the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that a caller on the phone you found asked you to bring it to the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その相手が持ち主であることを確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you verified that the caller owns it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、電話してきたので持ち主だと思いましたが、本人だと確かめてはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 着信だけで持ち主と思ったが本人確認は未済だと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I thought they owned it because they called, but I have not confirmed their identity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you assumed the caller was the owner but have not verified their identity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 指定された場所へは行きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Did you go to the place they specified?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 行っていません。知らない相手へ自分で渡す前に、こちらへ届けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定場所へ行かず自己引渡前に交番へ持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I brought it here before handing it over myself to someone I do not know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you did not go to the specified place and brought it to the police box before handing it over yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 電話に出た以外に、端末を操作していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you operated the phone other than answering that call?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: していません。持ち主を探すために写真や連絡先を開くこともしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 着信応答以外に端末内を見ていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I have not opened its photos or contacts to look for the owner either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not looked inside the phone other than answering the call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 拾った場所と、相手に伝えたことを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell me where you found it and what you told the caller.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 公園のベンチです。交番へ届けるとだけ伝え、私の住所や電話番号は知らせていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 拾得場所と伝達内容と自分の個人情報未共有を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: On a park bench. I only said I would take it to a police box; I did not give my address or phone number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the location, what you told the caller and that you did not share your own personal details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。拾った場所、着信で言われたこと、実際の操作を分けて記録します。現物をこちらへお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will record separately where you found it, what the caller said and what you actually did on it. Please hand over the phone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 宛先の確認についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about checking the addressee?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、新しい家に家族と似た名前の封筒が来ました。家族の物だと思って持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族に似た宛名の封筒を持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. An envelope arrived at our new home with a name similar to a family member’s, so I brought it thinking it was theirs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you brought an envelope addressed to a name similar to your family member’s. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 漢字や部屋番号まで同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are the kanji and apartment number exactly the same too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 漢字が一文字違い、部屋も隣でした。似た名前だけで見ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 漢字一字と隣室番号の相違を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: One kanji is different, and the apartment is next door. I had only noticed the similar name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the one-character difference and the neighboring apartment number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご家族宛てとは分けて扱いを確認します。封は開いていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check how to handle it separately from mail for your family. Is it still sealed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 開いていません。家族の転送が失敗した証拠とは言わず、この封筒の誤配の相談をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封で家族転送と別の誤配相談だと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I do not want to call this proof that my family’s mail forwarding failed; I want to ask about the incorrect delivery of this envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that it is unopened and this is a misdelivery inquiry separate from your family’s mail forwarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当に確認します。隣の方のお名前は確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check with the person in charge. Have you confirmed your neighbor’s name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 知りません。部屋が書かれていても、自分で開けて中身を確かめず、こちらへ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手は未確認で開封せず担当相談すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not know it. Even though an apartment number is written, I will ask you instead of opening it myself to check the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the person is unconfirmed and you will ask the staff without opening the envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今後、ご家族の郵便も宛名を丁寧にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the addressee carefully on your family’s mail too from now on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、名前と部屋番号を合わせて見ます。今回の封筒は私たちの郵便と分けてお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛名と部屋を照合し本人郵便から分けて渡すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check the name together with the apartment number. I will hand this envelope over separately from our own mail.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will compare the name and apartment number and hand it over separately from your own mail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。未開封の状態でお預かりし、宛先と配達状況を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will take it unopened, and the person in charge will check the address and delivery details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録のお名前の変更ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to change your registered name, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。古い署名を消して新しい姓を書けば、変更できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧署名を消して新姓を書けば変更できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Can I change it by erasing the old signature and writing my new surname?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether erasing the old signature and writing the new surname will change the registration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 登録変更の手続きと、署名の扱いを担当に確認します。書類にはまだ書き込んでいませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the registration procedure and how to handle the signature with the person in charge. You have not written on the documents yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。自分で古い署名を消す前に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未記入で自分で消す前に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I want to ask before erasing the old signature myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not filled anything in and want to check before erasing anything yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新しい姓が確認できる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have documents showing your new surname?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。名前が変わったことを示す資料と、現在の本人書類を持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 改姓資料と現本人書類を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I have documents showing the name change and my current identification.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your name-change documents and current identification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人の口座として変更を確認します。別人の口座への変更ではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the change to your own account. This is not changing it to someone else’s account, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、同じ私の口座です。口座そのものを譲る話ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じ本人の口座で譲渡ではないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Correct. It is still my own account. I am not transferring the account itself to anyone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear that it is the same person’s account, not an account transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: カードなどの扱いも担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will also explain what to do with your card and other items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。登録変更、署名、手元のカードで何が必要かを分けて確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 登録名と署名とカードの必要手続を分けて聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I would like to check separately what is needed for the registration change, signature and card I have.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask separately about the procedures for the registered name, signature and card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご本人の情報を確認し、変更する項目と各手続きを説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will verify your information and explain each item to change and its procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 容量の大きい商品をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a larger size?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、この瓶なら期限が三か月後なので、少しずつ三か月使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 印字期限まで開封後も少量ずつ使えるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. This jar’s date is three months away, so can I use a little at a time for three months?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can keep using a little after opening until the printed date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その期限の条件と、開封後の案内を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the conditions for that date separately from the instructions after opening.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開封後は早めにとありますね。印字した日まで同じ条件で保存できると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 開封後注意を読み期限条件の混同を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says to use it soon after opening. I thought I could store it under the same conditions until the printed date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the after-opening warning and explain that you confused the conditions for the date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 保存方法も表示をご覧ください。どのくらいの量を使う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also check the storage instructions. How much do you expect to use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人で週に少し使います。大きい方が安くても、使い切るまでのことを考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人の少量使用で大容量の使切りを考えたいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I live alone and use a little each week. Even if the larger size is cheaper, I want to consider whether I can finish it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you use small amounts alone and want to consider finishing a large size. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 小さい容量も比較できます。開封後の具体的な扱いが不明なら問い合わせが必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can compare smaller sizes too. If the specific handling after opening is unclear, you will need to inquire.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、何日と自分で決めず、表示と問い合わせ先を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自己判断で日数を設定せず表示と照会先確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not decide the number of days myself; I will check the label and whom to contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not set a number of days yourself and ask to check the label and inquiry contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日はどちらを選ばれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Which would you like to choose today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示の条件を確認して、小さい瓶を候補にします。大きい瓶の期限だけでは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件確認後に小容量を候補にし長い期限だけで選ばないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: After checking the label conditions, I will consider the smaller jar. I will not decide just because the large jar has a distant date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will consider a smaller size after checking conditions, rather than choose only by the long date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。未開封の期限、開封後の案内、使う量を合わせてお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13224-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Consider the unopened date, after-opening instructions and amount you use together when choosing.
